rubric_notes: All must_include met: SCOPe 2.08, class/fold/superfamily/family hierarchy with correct SUNIDs (47112, 47113, 47114, 47129, 47134, 101318), four families named including bacterial histone-fold. States fold alone is structural similarity, superfamily implies homology (cites homology endpoint, supported in bundle). Family distinctions preserved; explicitly rejects transfer of nucleosome assembly, DNA-binding specificity, partners and SOS catalytic activity. Linker histones correctly placed in a.4.5.13/a.4.5/a.4; HU/IHF, H-NS and modifying enzymes excluded by name alone. Bacterial-family duplication annotation supported by bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families a.204.1.2 and a.204.1.4, superfamily a.204.1 (SUNID 101386), fold a.204 (SUNID 101385), class a (SUNID 46456), domain boundaries, and protein names; SCCS and domain SUNIDs are supported by the resolve endpoints in the bundle, and the family SUNIDs 116993/140797 and protein labels, while not in this bundle, are correct release 2.08 values rather than fabrications. Correctly assigns the evolutionary inference to the superfamily, not fold or class, rejects bidirectional HisE/MazG transfer including template use for substrate specificity, and names required external evidence. Complete. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-16.

Family SCCS/SUNIDs, superfamily c.55.1/53067, fold c.55 and class c all correct. Infers remote common ancestry and divergence of an ancestral ATP-utilizing core, distinguishes this from fold/class similarity, rejects transfer of substrate, mechanism, EC annotation and cellular function, warns against treating members as equivalent actin/chaperone ATPases, and lists required external evidence. Regulation/oligomeric state not named explicitly but limits are clearly conveyed.

Complete: correct release 2.08 hierarchy with SCCS and SUNIDs for families (47241, 47253, 100951), superfamily 47240, fold 47239, class 46456; explains superfamily implies ancestry while fold/class do not; describes divergent chemistries; cautions that the RNR-like label does not mean every member reduces nucleotides; rejects transfer of function, metal specificity, oligomeric state; requires sequence/active-site comparison, metal/cofactor evidence, and biochemical characterization. Identifiers are correct public SCOPe values. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16. Correct families, SUNIDs (49504, 74874, 110107), superfamily 49503, fold 49502, class 48724; Greek-key sandwich description matches fold annotation. States superfamily-level proposed evolutionary relationship, stronger than fold. Cites both family comments 'probably related to cupredoxins but lacking the metal-binding site'. Rejects copper/electron-transfer transfer, notes PAD4 N-terminal domain is not the catalytic domain, and requires conserved coordinating residues with geometry, direct metal-binding evidence, and biochemical/spectroscopic electron-transfer evidence. Complete.

Correct family/superfamily/fold/class identifiers with SUNIDs supported by evidence. Clearly distinguishes superfamily-level homology from fold/class topology, describes the divergent functions, and explicitly rejects transferring conjugation, proteasomal targeting, p97 binding, and Ras binding across families; lists required external evidence.

Correct 2.08 identifiers for c.23.1.1/52173, c.23.1.4/52252, c.23.1.5/82344, superfamily 52172, fold 52171, class 51349, supported by the c.23.1 children, parents and homology responses. Correctly states fold/class describe topology and do not establish homology while shared superfamily supports probable common ancestry despite functional divergence. Rejects transfer of phosphorylation competence, kinase partners, chemotaxis, PLP decarboxylation, and clock roles; explicitly says the relationship concerns the classified domains, not whole-protein architectures. KaiA annotation supported by 82344 annotations. Lists external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Gives b.84.5 (310577), b.84.5.1 (310616), fold b.84 (51229), class b; names sibling superfamilies; explains fold = structural similarity, superfamily = homologous group, family = closer members (V1 and A1 bulge domains); states separation does not prove convergence; rejects ATPase function/template transfer; scopes claim to bulge domain only. All identifiers supported by bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete. Correct SCCS/SUNIDs, class, and fold description supported by annotations endpoint. Clear family vs superfamily vs fold semantics; states separate superfamilies do not prove independent origins; rejects functional transfer; requires sequence/profile, detailed structural evolutionary evidence, and biochemical support. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families, superfamily, fold and class with SUNIDs; all are correct public identifiers (bundle search results show the family nodes under parent 51735). Clearly distinguishes superfamily (homology) from fold/class (architecture only), describes divergence of the Rossmann scaffold, explicitly refuses transfer of ADH activity, CoA specificity, NAD/NADP preference and channel regulation, states the relationship concerns domains not whole proteins, and lists required external evidence.

All must_include met: shared family k.40.1.1 'Designed trimeric coiled-coil' SUNID 100905, 'not a true family' annotation, explicit statement that the generic family-level homology flag must be overridden by the caveat. Correct SUNIDs 98768/61142, class k, fold k.40, superfamily k.40.1. Rejects amyloidogenicity transfer, names required independent evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met in substance: 1.69 c.137.1.1 in own fold c.137 vs 1f8y c.23.14.1 in c.23; 2.08 c.23.14.2 vs c.23.14.1 under shared superfamily c.23.14 (SUNID 52309); SID change d1t1ja_ to d1t1ja1 (1-118) with SUNID 106249 retained; explicitly states this is stronger than structural resemblance and recognizes probable common ancestry while not transferring function. Weakness: the evidence bundle contains only four resolve calls (one of which resolved c.23.14.2 to a species node), so the stated domain SUNID, SID, and 1-118 boundary are not backed by any cited response; these values are correct but unsupported. Minor: d1f8ya_ SID not named. No must_avoid violation. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met: d1a14h2 H:1-8, SUNID 343393, l.1.1.1 with Tags/Tags/Tags/Artifacts lineage described as synthetic N-terminal tag; d1a14h1 H:9-111, SUNID 20061, b.1.1.1 V-set. Correctly frames artifact categories as bookkeeping rather than evolutionary assertions, rejects homology, function transfer, and template selection from tag similarity, recommends masking, and requires evidence across the biological domain. Identifiers match the bundle. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Correct 1.75 single domain and 2.08 split with correct boundaries/classifications/SUNIDs. Strong evolutionary-module reasoning, rejects whole-protein toxin transfer and cross-module inference, states limits. Compares 1.75 vs 2.08 only, omitting the 2.04 first-split (honestly caveated).

All five domains correct with SIDs, boundaries, SCCS, family/superfamily/fold and class placements; d3jb9a5 as new fold d.394 (SUNID 345891) and its helical-core description are supported by the bundle. Interprets the decomposition as assembly and divergence of older modules plus structural innovation, flags the group II intron ancestry as interpretation rather than SCOPe-established phylogeny, states that family/superfamily imply ancestry while fold/class do not, rejects function transfer, notes a new fold is not de novo proof, and adds the caveat that the five entries cover only classified regions of this structure.

Correct family placement, SEQRES lengths supported by its sequence bundle, sound repeat-homology and length-heterogeneity reasoning, and good family-vs-fold homology nuance plus safe-transfer caveats. Omits the re heterogeneity annotation and representative repeat unit required by the gold criteria.

All release metadata is correct and supported by the bundled /releases/current, /releases, and service-index bodies. Cites 2.08-stable for the frozen dataset or the exact dated identifier 2.08-2026-08-16 for the periodic snapshot, and explicitly rejects citing only current/latest. Explains the periodic label as additional automated classifications incorporated under the existing 2.08 classification framework rather than a new stable release or new hierarchy, which is equivalent to adding newly classified entries without rewriting stable domains. No material errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Covers all must_include items: shared a.47.2.1 placement with full lineage, the explicit three-helical fragment/spectrin-repeat comment and ms record, the STAT-like four-long-helix fold description, and the conclusion that the fuller 1dn1B supplies the missing context so fragment assignments must be revised while keeping caveats. Correctly distinguishes family/superfamily homology from fold-level similarity and rejects spectrin/STAT function transfer. Periodic-update label and 3c98 obsolescence are not in this bundle but are not erroneous. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

c.2.1/51735, c.1.7/51430 in TIM fold c.1, c.3.1/51905 verified in search bundle; convergence alongside divergence with explicit caveat that different assignments do not prove independent origins; hierarchy semantics, evidence integration, and transfer/representative caveats complete. Claim that 'the API reports SCOPe 2.08 as the current release' is not supported by its bundle (no releases endpoint cited; search was release-specified). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Accurate SUNIDs and SCCS for both releases, shared superfamily b.18.1, distinct families. Topology (9-strand jelly-roll) and PMID 17977833 context given; honestly notes no retrieved 1nqd-1dlc alignment and no RMSD claim. Strong caveats, no toxin-as-proof.

Complete: correct SUNIDs, boundaries (A:0-59), lineage; hf correctly defined and noted as not revoking homology (homology_implied_by_level true in bundle); mutant and 'complexed with nhe' comments cited. Rejects coordinate template substitution, contact/DNA geometry transfer, and canonical-topology equivalence; recommends stratifying/flagging d1ztra1 and leakage control. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct SUNIDs for domains, family, superfamily, fold and class; boundaries; fr definition; d1uc6a1 unflagged; useful note that similar span lengths do not imply equal completeness. Alignment: mask missing data, report aligned length and coverage alongside identity, fragment match does not show full-domain agreement. Representative: prefer d1uc6a1 only if completeness and quality verified, retain fragment with explicit limitations. Diversity and function-transfer caveats complete. No concrete quality fields (method, resolution, AEROSPACI) supplied for the recommendation. No errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete: new superfamily given same fold topology; family asserts probable ancestry and closer evolutionary grouping; new fold needs distinct overall arrangement, sequence novelty insufficient; explicitly a revisable evolutionary hypothesis with named evidence types (profile searches, structural alignment, mechanistic features). Notes new superfamily does not prove independent origin. Function transfer caveats correct. No factual errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Family, superfamily, fold, and class identifiers with SUNIDs all match the bundle. Excellent reasoning: superfamily implies probable common ancestry, fold does not; shared two-lobed phosphoryl-transfer framework with explicit caveat about inactive pseudokinases; rejects transfer of protein, aminoglycoside, and lipid specificity and of activation-loop/APH/PI3K regulatory mechanisms; comprehensive evidence requirements. Minor factual issue: the claim that the release is 'reported as current' with periodic update 2.08-2026-08-16 is an API-dependent statement not backed by any endpoint in this answer's bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-16.
